behavior: On the first failed parallel upload, stop assigning files and abort the upload-scoped signal.
Wait for every started PUT to settle before returning the error and allowing R2/work-directory cleanup.
Pass AbortSignal through the S3 PutObject request and destroy its file stream when the request settles.
Keep upload failure cancellation separate from job cancellation so a transient PUT error remains retryable.

redRegression.command: npx vitest run tests/unit/video-pipeline/process-encode-job.test.ts -t 'waits for every started upload' --reporter=verbose
redRegression.observed: Before the fix, cleanup event index 5 preceded the in-flight upload completion at event index 7.

limitations: No Cloudflare R2 or other S3-compatible sandbox was used; provider cancellation timing remains unverified.
No full public/admin build was run for this worker/storage change.
K14 remains open for independent review and provider-backed acceptance; local tests do not close K16 attempt isolation.
